question: The ________ scheme of Rajasthan was launched in collaboration with ‘IPE Global’, which provides the rural girls of the state with scholarship schemes by enrolling them at the secondary level.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Udaan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Udaan scheme was launched by the Government of Rajasthan in collaboration with 'IPE Global'.
 
• The aim of the scheme is to provide scholarships to rural girls to encourage their enrollment at the secondary level of education.
 
• This initiative is part of the broader efforts to improve female education and reduce gender disparity in education in rural areas.
 
• By providing financial support, the scheme aims to reduce the dropout rates of girls at the secondary level and promote higher education among rural girls.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Begum Hazrat Scholarship:**

 
 
• Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship is a scheme for meritorious girl students belonging to minority communities.
 
• It aims to provide financial assistance to girls in the minority community to reduce their dropout rate and promote higher education.
 
• This scholarship is provided by the Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India.
 
 
 
• **Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao:**
 
 
• Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao (BBBP) is a national campaign to save and educate the girl child.
 
• It was launched by the Government of India to address the declining child sex ratio and promote the education of girls.
 
• BBBP focuses on changing mindsets and creating awareness about the importance of girls' education and their rights.
 
 
 
• **Yuvika:**
 
 
• Yuvika, also known as the Young Scientist Programme, is an initiative by ISRO to impart basic knowledge on space technology and its applications to school students.
 
• It aims to create interest in space activities among young students and encourage them to pursue careers in space science and technology.
